items: 【Compatible with TV Series】This remote control works with Hisense Smart Google TV U7 A65H A4K A6H A7H U6 U6H U7H U8H L5H U6K U7K U8K U75K UX U76 A76K L9 A65K Series

【Work Out of the Box】Just need to insert 2*AAA alkaline batteries and the remote control is ready to use, without complicated pairing steps, allowing you to enjoy the convenience of your smart device instantly. (Noted: Batteries are not included)

【6 Function Keys】To enhance your convenience and comfort when using the remote control, this remote control features with 6 shortcut function keys, including NETFLIX, prime video, YouTube, Disney, tubi and Peacock

【Efficient and Stable Transmission】Adopting cutting edge infrared technology, this remote control is able to achieve a signal transmission distance of up to 40 feet and boasts the fastest response time of 0.2 seconds, bringing you both efficient and stable usage
【High Durability】This remote control is made of high quality ABS plastic so that ensures durability and non-slip grip. Using upgraded silicone, the buttons are soft and sensitive button
